cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Help me write the complaint as a colleague, not my parent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was only correcting your spelling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then leave the angry sentence. That's my contribution.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put both our names under it, not 'on behalf of.'

mechanism: A corrects the scope of editing and sending help so the complaint becomes a shared colleague action rather than parental representation.
confusable: D204 seeks one claim; D217 uses how help arrives to change the relationship.
comparison: Written collaboration and joint responsibility differ from physical moving decisions.
seedUse: Keep accepted angry sentence but make removal/sending proposals explicit before A corrects them.
